findings.problem: Said of a daughter, pequeña most naturally means young rather than physically small, so the example doesn't clearly show the size meaning the learner is memorizing.
findings.fix: example.es: Mi casa es muy pequeña. example.en: My house is very small.

back.example: My daughter is very little (most naturally: very young).

note: In much of Latin America chico (and chiquito) also commonly means small, but pequeño is the standard answer a fluent speaker would give for "small", so no hint is strictly required.
